description: Your work for Morgan Stern in Dustwallow Marsh, ending with ... and Bugs, leads you back to Angus Stern at the Blue Recluse.
intro: Your work for Morgan Stern in Dustwallow Marsh, ending with ... and Bugs, leads you back to Angus Stern at the Blue Recluse.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My nephew said you aided him with his research in Dustwallow, and that you helped his associate out of a tight spot. Well, we Sterns stick together and we don't ignore our friends!
So wash your hands, friend, because we're about to throw a party in your honor!
